declarations.name: MainTheory.D3AffineRankBound.d3_bound_same_class_at_affineRank
declarations.type:
∀ {n d : ℕ} (C : MainTheory.CodeSpec.ExactCode n 2 d),
  3 ≤ d →
    ∀
      (v :
        ↥(MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.diagonalSymmetryGroup
            (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C)))
      (theta : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin n), Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑(theta j)) = ↑(↑v j)) →
        MainTheory.CodeSpec.CodePreserving C.frame (MainTheory.PhaseSectorBridge.realGateEnd theta) →
          MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C)
                v ≠
              1 →
            ∃ F eigenvalue q,
              MainTheory.CodeSpec.codeSpan C.frame = MainTheory.CodeSpec.codeSpan F ∧
                SS.HasDistance F.vec d ∧
                  eigenvalue 0 ≠ eigenvalue 1 ∧
                    (∀ (k : Fin 2), MainTheory.RealGate.realGate theta (F.vec k) = fun s => eigenvalue k * F.vec k s) ∧
                      MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (F.vec 0) =
                          MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (F.vec 1) ∧
                        MainTheory.GeneralLiftOrder.HasPrimitiveLift C
                            (MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass
                              (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C) v)
                            q ∧
                          orderOf
                                (MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass
                                  (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C) v) ∣
                              q ∧
                            2 ≤ q ∧
                              q ≤
                                  MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf
                                    (MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (F.vec 0)) ∧
                                MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf
                                    (MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (F.vec 0)) ≤
                                  MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf n

declarations.name: MainTheory.D3OriginalRealPivot.for_eigenframe
declarations.type:
∀ {n q : ℕ} [inst : NeZero q] (C : MainTheory.CodeSpec.ExactCode n 2 3)
  (G : MainTheory.RankTwoGlobal.FiniteGeneratorResolution C q) (theta : Fin n → ℝ) (ev : Fin 2 → ℂ),
  ev 0 ≠ ev 1 →
    (∀ (k : Fin 2), MainTheory.RealGate.realGate theta (G.eigenFrame.vec k) = fun x => ev k * G.eigenFrame.vec k x) →
      ∃ T F Gb,
        Gb.eigenFrame = G.eigenFrame ∧
          MainTheory.CodeSpec.SameProjectiveOnCode C.frame (MainTheory.RankTwoGlobal.finiteGateEnd Gb.zeta Gb.angle)
              (MainTheory.PhaseSectorBridge.realGateEnd theta) ∧
            F.basis.rank = MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (G.eigenFrame.vec 0) ∧
              F.data.order ∣ MainTheory.DeterminantalFactor.lastInvariantFactor F.data.minor ∧
                2 ≤ F.data.order ∧
                  F.data.order ≤ MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf F.basis.rank ∧
                    MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf F.basis.rank ≤ MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf n

declarations.name: MainTheory.D3OriginalRealPivot.full_sparse_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {n d : ℕ} (C : MainTheory.CodeSpec.ExactCode n 2 d) (hd : 3 ≤ d)
  (v :
    ↥(MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.diagonalSymmetryGroup
        (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C)))
  (theta : Fin n → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin n), Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑(theta j)) = ↑(↑v j)) →
    MainTheory.CodeSpec.CodePreserving C.frame (MainTheory.PhaseSectorBridge.realGateEnd theta) →
      MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C) v ≠
          1 →
        let C3 := MainTheory.SSLPCompleteness.weakenDistance hd C;
        ∃ q,
          ∃ (x : NeZero q),
            ∃ Gb r A,
              SS.HasDistance Gb.eigenFrame.vec d ∧
                MainTheory.CodeSpec.SameProjectiveOnCode C.frame
                    (MainTheory.RankTwoGlobal.finiteGateEnd Gb.zeta Gb.angle)
                    (MainTheory.PhaseSectorBridge.realGateEnd theta) ∧
                  Gb.intrinsicClass =
                      MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass
                        (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C) v ∧
                    r = MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (Gb.eigenFrame.vec 0) ∧
                      MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (Gb.eigenFrame.vec 0) =
                          MainTheory.RealSupportAffineRank.supportAffineRank (Gb.eigenFrame.vec 1) ∧
                        1 ≤ r ∧
                          r ≤ n ∧
                            MainTheory.BinaryBeta.IsZeroOne A ∧
                              A.det ≠ 0 ∧
                                orderOf
                                      (MainTheory.ClassificationLevels.intrinsicClass
                                        (MainTheory.GlobalClassificationBridge.exactCodeProjector C) v) ∣
                                    q ∧
                                  q ∣ MainTheory.DeterminantalFactor.lastInvariantFactor A ∧
                                    2 ≤ q ∧
                                      q ≤ MainTheory.DeterminantalFactor.lastInvariantFactor A ∧
                                        MainTheory.DeterminantalFactor.lastInvariantFactor A ≤
                                            MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf r ∧
                                          MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf r ≤ MainTheory.BetaExists.betaOf n

                          SixQubit.Orbit21Coef.tset).sum +

                3 * MainTheory.Orbit21FarkasDisplay.selectedA psi SixQubit.Orbit21Coef.r3set +

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit26.C3_not_isUnit
declarations.type:
∀ {C D : Fin 3 → MainTheory.Orbit26.M2} {C3 D3 : MainTheory.Orbit26.M2},
  (∀ (g : Fin 3), Matrix.conjTranspose C3 * D g + (Matrix.conjTranspose (C g) * D3).transpose = 0) →
    (∀ (g h : Fin 3),
        g ≠ h →
          MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g) * MainTheory.Orbit26.Jmat * Matrix.transpose (D h) +
              MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C h) * MainTheory.Orbit26.Jmat * Matrix.transpose (D g) =
            0) →
      ∑ g, C g * Matrix.conjTranspose (C g) = C3 * Matrix.conjTranspose C3 + 2 • (D3 * Matrix.conjTranspose D3) →
        (∀ (g : Fin 3), C g ≠ 0) →
          (∃ g, ¬(C g 0 0 = 0 ∧ C g 1 0 = 0) ∧ ¬(C g 0 1 = 0 ∧ C g 1 1 = 0)) →
            (¬IsUnit (Matrix.det D3) →
                ∃ d,
                  ∑ i, Complex.normSq (d i) = 1 ∧
                    D3 * Matrix.conjTranspose D3 = (1 / 4) • Matrix.vecMulVec d (Star.star d)) →
              (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                  ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                    ∀ (g : Fin 3),
                      Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g)) 0) +
                          Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g)) 1) ≤
                        1 / 4) →
                (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                    ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                      ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                        Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 0)) j) +
                              Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 1)) j) +
                            Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 2)) j) ≤
                          3 / 8) →
                  ¬IsUnit (Matrix.det C3)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit26.D3_not_isUnit

    (∀ (g h : Fin 3),
        g ≠ h →
          MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g) * MainTheory.Orbit26.Jmat * Matrix.transpose (D h) +
              MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C h) * MainTheory.Orbit26.Jmat * Matrix.transpose (D g) =
            0) →
      ∑ g, D g * Matrix.conjTranspose (D g) = D3 * Matrix.conjTranspose D3 + 2 • (C3 * Matrix.conjTranspose C3) →
        (∀ (g : Fin 3), D g ≠ 0) →
          (∃ g, ¬(D g 0 0 = 0 ∧ D g 1 0 = 0) ∧ ¬(D g 0 1 = 0 ∧ D g 1 1 = 0)) →
            (¬IsUnit (Matrix.det C3) →
                ∃ d,
                  ∑ i, Complex.normSq (d i) = 1 ∧
                    C3 * Matrix.conjTranspose C3 = (1 / 4) • Matrix.vecMulVec d (Star.star d)) →
              (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                  ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                    ∀ (g : Fin 3),
                      Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D g)) 0) +
                          Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D g)) 1) ≤
                        1 / 4) →
                (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                    ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                      ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                        Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 0)) j) +
                              Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 1)) j) +
                            Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 2)) j) ≤

        ∑ g, D g * Matrix.conjTranspose (D g) = D3 * Matrix.conjTranspose D3 + 2 • (C3 * Matrix.conjTranspose C3) →
          (∀ (g : Fin 3), C g ≠ 0) →
            (∀ (g : Fin 3), D g ≠ 0) →
              (∃ g, ¬(C g 0 0 = 0 ∧ C g 1 0 = 0) ∧ ¬(C g 0 1 = 0 ∧ C g 1 1 = 0)) →
                (∃ g, ¬(D g 0 0 = 0 ∧ D g 1 0 = 0) ∧ ¬(D g 0 1 = 0 ∧ D g 1 1 = 0)) →
                  (¬IsUnit (Matrix.det D3) →
                      ∃ d,
                        ∑ i, Complex.normSq (d i) = 1 ∧
                          D3 * Matrix.conjTranspose D3 = (1 / 4) • Matrix.vecMulVec d (Star.star d)) →
                    (¬IsUnit (Matrix.det C3) →
                        ∃ d,
                          ∑ i, Complex.normSq (d i) = 1 ∧
                            C3 * Matrix.conjTranspose C3 = (1 / 4) • Matrix.vecMulVec d (Star.star d)) →
                      (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                          ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                            ∀ (g : Fin 3),
                              Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g)) 0) +
                                  Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C g)) 1) ≤
                                1 / 4) →
                        (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                            ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                              ∀ (g : Fin 3),
                                Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D g)) 0) +
                                    Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D g)) 1) ≤
                                  1 / 4) →
                          (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                              ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                                ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                                  Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 0)) j) +
                                        Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 1)) j) +
                                      Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (C 2)) j) ≤
                                    3 / 8) →
                            (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℂ),
                                ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) = 1 →
                                  ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                                    Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 0)) j) +
                                          Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 1)) j) +
                                        Complex.normSq (Matrix.vecMul w (MainTheory.Orbit26.cj (D 2)) j) ≤

                  (Complex.normSq (d SixQubit.Orbit29.z2)) (Complex.normSq (d SixQubit.Orbit29.z0)) ∧
              MainTheory.Orbit29PrintedSimplex.probabilities d MainTheory.Orbit29PrintedSimplex.ys =
                MainTheory.Orbit29PrintedSimplex.normalR (Complex.normSq (d SixQubit.Orbit29.z4))

                (MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedActiveMasses.a V + MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedActiveMasses.u V +
                    MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedActiveMasses.v V +
                  MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedPurityMasses.w V)) -
            2 * MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedActiveMasses.u V -
          2 * MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedActiveMasses.v V -
        4 * MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedPurityMasses.w V +
      MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedPurityMasses.mass V MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedPurityMasses.H3

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedCContractions.multiplier_decomposition
declarations.type:
∀ (p : Orbit2.TensorPauli.Label 4) (v y : Fin 32),
  Orbit2.Quartic.cMultiplier p v y =
    (((if MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedCContractions.V3 p then -24 else 0) +
          if MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedCContractions.F4 p then
            (68 * if (Orbit2.Quartic.isThree y != Orbit2.Quartic.isThree v) = Bool.true then 1 else 0) +
              76 * if (Orbit2.Quartic.isThree y && Orbit2.Quartic.isThree v) = Bool.true then 1 else 0
          else 0) +
        if MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedCContractions.D3 p then
          100 * if (Orbit2.Quartic.isThree y != Orbit2.Quartic.isThree v) = Bool.true then 1 else 0
        else 0) +
      if MainTheory.Orbit2PrintedCContractions.D2 p then
        8 * if (Orbit2.Quartic.isThree y && Orbit2.Quartic.isThree v) = Bool.true then 1 else 0
      else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.product_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (P : Fin 3 → SS.PauliString 6) (w : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.totalY P % 2 = 0 →
    MainTheory.Orbit3CliffordAverage.product P w =
      MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.phase P *
        ∑ a,
          ∑ b,
            ∑ c,
              MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.character P (a, b, c) *
                MainTheory.Orbit3CubicPhaseStability.entry (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.shifted P (a, b, c))
                  (a, b, c) w

declarations.type:
∀ (W : MainTheory.Orbit3ScalarCategoryRealization.Encoder) (P : Fin 3 → SS.PauliString 6),
  SS.bxor (P 0).x (P 1).x = (P 2).x →
    SS.bxor (P 0).z (P 1).z = (P 2).z →
      MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.totalY P % 2 = 0 →
        ∑ g, MainTheory.Orbit3CliffordAverage.product P (MainTheory.Orbit3ActualSampling.wave W g) =
          MainTheory.Orbit3PauliMomentInterpretation.rawEvaluation P
            (MainTheory.Orbit3CoordinateRealization.coordinates W)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit3PauliTranslationReduction.triple_sum_reduction
declarations.type:
∀ (W : MainTheory.Orbit3ScalarCategoryRealization.Encoder) (P : Fin 3 → SS.PauliString 6),
  SS.bxor (P 0).z (P 1).z = (P 2).z →
    ∑ a,
        ∑ b,
          ∑ c,
            MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.character P (a, b, c) *
              ∑ g,
                MainTheory.Orbit3CubicPhaseStability.entry (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.shifted P (a, b, c))
                  (a, b, c) (MainTheory.Orbit3ActualSampling.wave W g) =
      64 *
        ∑ a,
          ∑ b,
            MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.character P (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliTranslationReduction.pair a b) *
              ∑ g,
                MainTheory.Orbit3CubicPhaseStability.entry
                  (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliCubicExpansion.shifted P (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliTranslationReduction.pair a b))
                  (MainTheory.Orbit3PauliTranslationReduction.pair a b) (MainTheory.Orbit3ActualSampling.wave W g)

      (MainTheory.DirectoryEnumeratorImages.angleFibers SixQubit.OpenLOrbit3.angle)),

      ∑ P,
        if MainTheory.PhysicalPauliCategories.category P = MainTheory.Orbit3Target.targetCategory then

                (SS.pauliAct P (MainTheory.Orbit3PrintedAmplitudes.w R.states))).re ^

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalCanonicalForm.physical_canonical_form
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalGauge.FullKL c d →
    0 <
        MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 1 * MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 0 *
          MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 2 →
      ∃ theta tau xi eta,
        have c' := MainTheory.Orbit45AffineGauge.phaseAction theta c;
        have d' := tau • MainTheory.Orbit45AffineGauge.phaseAction theta d;
        Star.star tau * tau = 1 ∧
          MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalGauge.FullKL c' d' ∧
            MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c' = MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c ∧
              Complex.normSq xi = 1 ∧
                Complex.normSq eta = 1 ∧
                  ↑(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 1) * xi +
                          ↑(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 0) * eta +
                        ↑(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 2) =
                      0 ∧
                    (fun i => c' (MainTheory.Orbit45PrintedFibers.bottom i)) =
                        MainTheory.Orbit45CrossFactors.C (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 1))
                          (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 0))
                          (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 2)) (1 / √8) (-1) (Star.star xi)
                          (Star.star eta) ∧
                      (fun i => d' (MainTheory.Orbit45PrintedFibers.top i)) =
                        MainTheory.Orbit45CrossFactors.D (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 1))
                          (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 0))
                          (√(MainTheory.Orbit45PhysicalPrintedRows.p c 2)) (1 / √8) (-1) (Star.star xi) (Star.star eta)
                          xi eta 1

declarations.type:

    ∀ (B G S h : ℝ) (U V W xi eta zeta : ℂ),
      0 < B →
        0 < G →
          0 < S →
            0 < h →
              Complex.normSq U = 1 →
                Complex.normSq V = 1 →
                  Complex.normSq W = 1 →
                    Complex.normSq xi = 1 →
                      Complex.normSq eta = 1 →
                        (fun i => c (MainTheory.Orbit45PrintedFibers.bottom i)) =
                            MainTheory.Orbit45CrossFactors.C B G S h U V W →
                          (fun i => d (MainTheory.Orbit45PrintedFibers.top i)) =
                              MainTheory.Orbit45CrossFactors.D B G S h U V W xi eta zeta →
                            U = -1 ∧ V = Star.star xi ∧ W = Star.star eta ∧ zeta = 1

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit7PauliPurityDisplay.universal_expansion
declarations.type:

  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit7Universal.uniformAv x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit7Universal.uniformAv x ≠ 2 → d x = 0) →

                      Complex.normSq

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8FamilyDisplays.universal_vectors
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            (fun j => MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] ↑j) =
              ![1, MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] 1,
                1 - MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] 1, 0,
                11 + 4 * MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] 1,
                16 - MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] 1,
                3 - 3 * MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA ![c, d] 1]

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8GramDisplay.raising_gram
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            SixQubit.Orbit8RaisingGram.raisingGram c =
              ((1 / 2) • 1 - 6 • Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i)) +
                3 •
                  have this := fun i j => SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d i * Star.star (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d j);
                  this

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.hafnian_formula
declarations.type:
∀ (d : SS.State 6 ℂ) (i j : Fin 6),
  i ≠ j →
    SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.compHaf d i j =
      SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 0)
              (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 1) *
            SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 2)
              (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 3) +
          SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 0)
              (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 2) *
            SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 1)
              (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 3) +
        SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 0)
            (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 3) *
          SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 1)
            (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j 2)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining_spec
declarations.type:
∀ (i j : Fin 6),
  i ≠ j →
    Function.Injective (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j) ∧
      Finset.image (MainTheory.Orbit8HafnianDisplays.remaining i j) Finset.univ = (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.local_ketbra_entries
declarations.type:
∀ (i : Fin 6) (x y : SS.BitString 6),
  MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.plusData i x y =
    if x i = Bool.true ∧ y i = Bool.false ∧ ∀ (j : Fin 6), j ≠ i → x j = y j then 1 else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.raising_action
declarations.type:
∀ (ud : Fin 6 → ℂ) (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.raise ud f = fun x => ∑ i, ud i * (MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.plus i).mulVec f x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.transpose_identities
declarations.type:
∀ (i : Fin 6),
  (MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.plus i * MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.spin).transpose =
      MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.spin * MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.minus i ∧
    MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.spin * MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.minus i =
      -(MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.plus i * MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.spin)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8OccupationDisplays.incident_row
declarations.type:
∀ (d : SS.State 6 ℂ) (i : Fin 6),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.D d i = ∑ j, if j ≠ i then SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.w d i j else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8OccupationDisplays.one_display
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (i : Fin 6),
              SixQubit.occOn SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d i =
                SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i + 5 / 6 - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.D d i

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8OccupationDisplays.two_display
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (ij : SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.Pair6),
              SixQubit.occ2On SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d (↑ij).1 (↑ij).2 =
                5 / 6 - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.D d (↑ij).1 - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.D d (↑ij).2 +
                  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.w d (↑ij).1 (↑ij).2

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8PairDensity.actual_pair_density
declarations.type:
∀ (C S : ℝ),
  C ^ 2 + S ^ 2 = 1 →
    SixQubit.Orbit7DirectMarginal.directPairMarginal (SixQubit.Orbit8Family.code C S) 3 =
      MainTheory.Orbit8PairDensity.density C S

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.Q_pauli_all
declarations.type:
∀ (ud : Fin 6 → ℂ) (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.Qact ud f = fun x =>
    ↑(∑ i, Complex.normSq (ud i)) / 2 * f x +
      ∑ P ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.lowPaulis, MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient ud P * SS.pauliAct P f x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient_real
declarations.type:
∀ (ud : Fin 6 → ℂ) (P : SS.PauliString 6),
  Star.star (MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient ud P) = MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient ud P

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient_square_chain
declarations.type:
∀ (ud : Fin 6 → ℂ),
  ∑ P ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.lowPaulis, (MainTheory.Orbit8PauliCoefficients.coefficient ud P).re ^ 2 =
      1 / 4 * ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ud i) ^ 2 +
        1 / 2 * ∑ ij ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.pairs6, Complex.normSq (ud ij.1) * Complex.normSq (ud ij.2) ∧
    1 / 4 * ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ud i) ^ 2 +
        1 / 2 * ∑ ij ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.pairs6, Complex.normSq (ud ij.1) * Complex.normSq (ud ij.2) =
      (∑ i, Complex.normSq (ud i)) ^ 2 / 4

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.normalized_pair
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ball (MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c) =
                ↑MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.b ∧
              (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6),
                  SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 →
                    (MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c) x = 0) ∧
                SS.innerC (MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c)
                      (MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c) =
                    1 ∧
                  SS.HasDistance ![MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c, d] 3

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ProjectorNormalization.normalized_kernel
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel ![MainTheory.Orbit8PhaseNormalization.phase c • c, d] =
              MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel ![c, d]

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8QDisplay.operator_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (ud : Fin 6 → ℂ) (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.Qact ud f = fun x =>
    ∑ i, ↑(Complex.normSq (ud i)) * (f x - SS.pauliAct (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.Pz i) f x) / 2 +
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j,
          if i = j then 0
          else
            ud i * Star.star (ud j) *
              (MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.plus i * MainTheory.Orbit8LadderMatrices.minus j).mulVec f x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ReconstructionDisplays.edge_mass_chain
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (i j : Fin 6),
              i ≠ j →
                SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.w d i j =
                    1 / 12 - (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i + SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d j) / 2 ∧
                  1 / 12 - (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i + SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d j) / 2 =
                      (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.r d - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d j) /
                        2 ∧
                    (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.r d - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d i - SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d j) /
                        2 =
                      1 / 2 * ∑ k, if k ≠ i ∧ k ≠ j then SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.p d k else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ReconstructionDisplays.hafnian_forced
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (i j : Fin 6), i ≠ j → SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d j * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.compHaf d i j = 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ReconstructionDisplays.triple_normalized
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (b : ℝ),
              SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ball c = ↑b →
                ∀ (i j k : Fin 6),
                  i ≠ j →
                    i ≠ k →
                      j ≠ k →
                        SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.a c i j k =
                          -(1 / ↑b) *
                            (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d i * Star.star (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d j k) +
                                SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d j * Star.star (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d i k) +
                              SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d k * Star.star (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d i j))

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8RotationSemantics.actual_family
declarations.type:
∀ (C S : ℝ),
  (MainTheory.Orbit8RotationSemantics.physicalRotation C S).mulVec SixQubit.Orbit8Real.w0 =
      SixQubit.Orbit8Family.w0 C S ∧
    (MainTheory.Orbit8RotationSemantics.physicalRotation C S).mulVec SixQubit.Orbit8Real.w1 =
      SixQubit.Orbit8Family.w1 C S

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ShellDisplays.fiber_residues
declarations.type:
∀ (x : SS.BitString 6),
  (x ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 ↔ SS.hammingWt x % 3 = 0) ∧
    (x ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 ↔ SS.hammingWt x % 3 = 1)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ShellDisplays.pair_cross_normalized
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
        ∀ (b : ℝ),
          SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ball c = ↑b →
            ∀ (i j : Fin 6),
              i ≠ j →
                ↑b * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d i j +
                    ∑ k with k ≠ i ∧ k ≠ j,
                      SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d k * Star.star (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.a c i j k) =
                  0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ShellDisplays.shell_linear
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 0 +
                    SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 3 +
                  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 6 =
                1 ∧
              3 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 3 +
                    6 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 6 =
                  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 1 +
                    4 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 4 ∧
                SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 1 +
                      4 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 4 =
                    1 + 3 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 4 ∧
                  3 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 3 +
                      15 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S0 c 6 =
                    6 * SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.shellMass SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.S1 d 4

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8ShellDisplays.support_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (S : Finset (SS.BitString 6)) (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ x ∉ S, f x = 0) → ∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), f x = ∑ y ∈ S, if x = y then f y else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spin_conjugate_action
declarations.type:
∀ (A : Matrix (SS.BitString 6) (SS.BitString 6) ℂ) (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ (A.mulVec (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ f)) =
    (MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spinConjugate A).mulVec f

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spin_family
declarations.type:
∀ (psi : Fin 2 → SS.State 6 ℂ),
  MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spinConjugate (MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel psi) =
    MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel fun i => SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ (psi i)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spinflip_enumerator
declarations.type:
∀ (psi : Fin 2 → SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel psi *
        MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spinConjugate (MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel psi)).trace =
    1 / 16 * ↑(∑ j, (-1) ^ ↑j * MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.normalizedA psi ↑j)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.trace_core
declarations.type:
∀ (psi : Fin 2 → SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel psi *
        MainTheory.Orbit8SpinProjector.spinConjugate (MainTheory.PairPartialTrace.familyKernel psi)).trace =
    SS.Shadow.core psi

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.normalized_ladder
declarations.type:
∀ (c d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
      SS.innerC c c = 1 →
        SS.innerC d d = 1 →
          SS.HasDistance ![c, d] 3 →
            ∀ (b : ℝ),
              SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ball c = ↑b →
                (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.raise (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d) (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ c) =
                    fun x => -↑b * d x) ∧
                  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.raise (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d) (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ d) =
                    fun x => ↑b * c x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.spinJ_basis
declarations.type:
∀ (x : SS.BitString 6),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ (MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket x) =
    ↑(SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinSign x) • MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket (SS.complement x)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.spinJ_pauli
declarations.type:
∀ (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ f = SS.pauliAct MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.allY fun x => Star.star (f x)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.spinJ_tensor
declarations.type:
∀ (f : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.spinJ f =
    Matrix.mulVec (MainTheory.LocalTensorKernel.tensorKernel fun x => MainTheory.PauliTransferTwo.pauli 2) fun x =>
      Star.star (f x)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8StateDisplays.bottom_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (c : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 0 → c x = 0) →
    c SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.zero6 = 0 →
      c = fun x =>
        SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ball c * MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.ones6 x +
          ∑ y with SS.hammingWt y = 3, c y * MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket y x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8StateDisplays.top_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (d : SS.State 6 ℂ),
  (∀ (x : SS.BitString 6), SS.weight SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.av x ≠ 1 → d x = 0) →
    d = fun x =>
      ∑ i, SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.u d i * MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket (SS.stdBasis i) x +
        ∑ ij ∈ SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.pairs6,
          SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.v d ij.1 ij.2 *
            MainTheory.Orbit8SpinSemantics.ket (SS.complement (SixQubit.Orbit8Universal.pairMask ij.1 ij.2)) x

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8TriangleDisplays.normalized_triangle
declarations.type: ∀ (xij xik xjk : ℂ), 1 * xjk + 1 * xik + 1 * xij = xij + xik + xjk

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8TriangleDisplays.scaling_zero_iff
declarations.type:
∀ (a b c d xab xac xad xbc xbd xcd : ℂ),
  a ≠ 0 →
    b ≠ 0 →
      c ≠ 0 →
        d ≠ 0 →
          (a * b * xab * (c * d * xcd) + a * c * xac * (b * d * xbd) + a * d * xad * (b * c * xbc) = 0 ↔
            xab * xcd + xac * xbd + xad * xbc = 0)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8TriangleDisplays.vertex_scaling
declarations.type:
∀ (a b c d xab xac xad xbc xbd xcd : ℂ),
  a * b * xab * (c * d * xcd) + a * c * xac * (b * d * xbd) + a * d * xad * (b * c * xbc) =
    a * b * c * d * (xab * xcd + xac * xbd + xad * xbc)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8TrigonometricDisplays.XX_YY_expectations
declarations.type:
∀ (theta : ℝ),
  MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.lambda (SixQubit.Orbit8Family.code (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta))
        SixQubit.Orbit8Family.PXX =
      -↑(Real.sin theta * Real.cos theta) ∧
    MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.lambda (SixQubit.Orbit8Family.code (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta))
        SixQubit.Orbit8Family.PYY =
      -↑(Real.sin theta * Real.cos theta)

declarations.name: MainTheory.Orbit8TrigonometricDisplays.Z_expectations
declarations.type:
∀ (theta : ℝ),
  MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.lambda (SixQubit.Orbit8Family.code (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta))
        SixQubit.Orbit8Family.PZ4 =
      -↑(Real.cos theta ^ 2) ∧
    MainTheory.Orbit8EnumeratorDisplays.lambda (SixQubit.Orbit8Family.code (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta))

declarations.name: MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.XX_YY
declarations.type:

                Orbit2.TensorPauli.operator (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.pair i j 1 1) *
              MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats)
            r s =
          (if r = i ∧ s = j then 1 else 0) + if r = j ∧ s = i then 1 else 0) ∧
        (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats.conjTranspose *
                Orbit2.TensorPauli.operator (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.pair i j 2 2) *
              MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats)
            r s =
          (if r = i ∧ s = j then 1 else 0) + if r = j ∧ s = i then 1 else 0

declarations.name: MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.ZZ
declarations.type:
∀ (i j : Fin 5),
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (r s : Fin 5),

              Orbit2.TensorPauli.operator (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.pair i j 3 3) *
            MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats)
          r s =
        ((if r = s then 1 else 0) - 2 * if r = i ∧ s = i then 1 else 0) - 2 * if r = j ∧ s = j then 1 else 0

        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) A
          (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats.conjTranspose * B *
            MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.cats) *
      MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatEncoder.spinors a b

                    (MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatCompression.pair i j p.succ.castSucc p.succ.castSucc)) *

declarations.type:

            MainTheory.PrimitiveOrderTwoCatEncoder.encoder a b =

      (∀ (b : C.ActiveResidue a), b = b0 ∨ b = b1) →

declarations.name: QECC.CodeProjector.exists_normalized_rankTwo_activeResidues
declarations.type:
∀ {n q m : ℕ} [NeZero q] (C : QECC.CodeProjector n 2) (hq : 0 < q) (a : Fin n → ZMod q)
  (hpres : C.Preserves ((QECC.phaseHom n q hq) a)),
  C.projectiveClassMap ⟨(QECC.phaseHom n q hq) a, hpres⟩ ≠ 0 →
    2 ≤ m →
      m ∣ q →
        addOrderOf (C.projectiveClassMap ⟨(QECC.phaseHom n q hq) a, hpres⟩) = m →
          ∃ b0 b1 u,
            b0 ≠ b1 ∧
              (∀ (b : C.ActiveResidue a), b = b0 ∨ b = b1) ∧
                Module.finrank ℂ ↥(C.phaseSector a ↑b0) = 1 ∧
                  Module.finrank ℂ ↥(C.phaseSector a ↑b1) = 1 ∧ ↑u * (↑b1 - ↑b0) = ↑(q / m)

declarations.name: QECC.CodeProjector.exists_primitive_sslp_colors
declarations.type:
∀ {n K : ℕ} (C : QECC.CodeProjector n K) (U : C.ProjectiveDiagonalGroup) (R : QECC.ReducedDiagonalRepresentative n)
  (hpres : C.Preserves R.phase) (b0 : C.ActiveResidue R.a) (H : C.IntrinsicSSLPData U R hpres b0),
  ∃ gamma,
    gamma b0 = 0 ∧
      Function.Injective gamma ∧
        (∀ (b : C.ActiveResidue R.a), (QECC.colorEmbed (addOrderOf U) R.q ⋯) (gamma b) = C.relativeResidues R.a b0 b) ∧
          QECC.ColorPrimitive (addOrderOf U) gamma ∧ QECC.colorGCD (addOrderOf U) gamma = 1

      C.projectiveClassMap ⟨(QECC.phaseHom n q hq) a, hpres⟩ ≠ 0 →
        2 ≤ m →
          m ∣ q →
            addOrderOf (C.projectiveClassMap ⟨(QECC.phaseHom n q hq) a, hpres⟩) = m →
              C.HasRankTwoCanonicalNormalization hq m a

declarations.name: QECC.general_sslp_directSum_converse
declarations.type:
∀ {n q : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (F : QECC.FiberProjectorFamily n q ι) (hq : 0 < q) (m d0 : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (hmq : m ∣ q) (i0 : ι) (gamma : ι → ZMod m),
      (∀ (i : ι), F.residue i = F.residue i0 + (QECC.colorEmbed m q hmq) (gamma i)) →
        QECC.ColorPrimitive m gamma →
          F.codeProjector.HasDistanceAtLeast d0 →
            (∀ (i : ι), 0 < F.multiplicity i) ∧
              Matrix.rank F.totalProjector = ∑ i, F.multiplicity i ∧
                F.codeProjector.Preserves ((QECC.phaseHom n q hq) F.coefficient) ∧
                  addOrderOf (F.codeProjector.projectiveClassMap ⟨(QECC.phaseHom n q hq) F.coefficient, ⋯⟩) = m ∧
                    F.codeProjector.HasDistanceAtLeast d0

              s0 * Star.star s0 + t0 * Star.star t0 = 3 / 10 →

                  p0 * Star.star p0 + s0 * Star.star s0 =

                        (p0 * Star.star p0 + p1 * Star.star p1 + p2 * Star.star p2 + p3 * Star.star p3 +

                                q4 * Star.star q4 +
                              q5 * Star.star q5) →
                        p3 * Star.star p3 + s3 * Star.star s3 =
                            1 / 5 *
                              (p0 * Star.star p0 + p1 * Star.star p1 + p2 * Star.star p2 + p3 * Star.star p3 +
                                  p4 * Star.star p4 +
                                p5 * Star.star p5) →

                                (p0 * Star.star q0 + p1 * Star.star q1 + p2 * Star.star q2 + p3 * Star.star q3 +

                                  p5 * Star.star q5) →

                  u k * Star.star (u l) + SixQubit.Trace5.fr a1 a2 a3 a4 k l =
                    SixQubit.Trace5.fr b1 b2 b3 b4 k l + v k * Star.star (v l)) →

declarations.name: SixQubit.Flip5.bell_G

  SixQubit.Trace5.nsq u = 1 / 3 →

      u 0 * Star.star (u 0) + u 1 * Star.star (u 1) = 1 / 6 ∧
        u 2 * Star.star (u 2) + u 3 * Star.star (u 3) = 1 / 6 ∧
          u 0 * Star.star (u 2) + u 1 * Star.star (u 3) = 0 ∧ u 2 * Star.star (u 0) + u 3 * Star.star (u 1) = 0

declarations.name: SixQubit.Flip5.bell_step
declarations.type:
∀ (u a b : Fin 4 → ℂ) (sc : ℂ),
  u 0 * Star.star (u 0) + u 1 * Star.star (u 1) = 1 / 6 →
    u 0 * Star.star (u 2) + u 1 * Star.star (u 3) = 0 →
      u 2 * Star.star (u 0) + u 3 * Star.star (u 1) = 0 →
        u 2 * Star.star (u 2) + u 3 * Star.star (u 3) = 1 / 6 →
          sc * (Star.star (u 0) * b 0 + Star.star (u 2) * b 2) + Star.star (a 0) * u 0 + Star.star (a 2) * u 2 = 0 →
            sc * (Star.star (u 1) * b 0 + Star.star (u 3) * b 2) + Star.star (a 1) * u 0 + Star.star (a 3) * u 2 = 0 →
              sc * (Star.star (u 0) * b 1 + Star.star (u 2) * b 3) + Star.star (a 0) * u 1 + Star.star (a 2) * u 3 = 0 →
                sc * (Star.star (u 1) * b 1 + Star.star (u 3) * b 3) + Star.star (a 1) * u 1 + Star.star (a 3) * u 3 =
                    0 →
                  sc * b 0 = -6 * SixQubit.Flip5.uau u a 0 ∧
                    sc * b 1 = -6 * SixQubit.Flip5.uau u a 1 ∧
                      sc * b 2 = -6 * SixQubit.Flip5.uau u a 2 ∧ sc * b 3 = -6 * SixQubit.Flip5.uau u a 3

      sc * bi 2 = -6 * SixQubit.Flip5.uau u ai 2 →
